PraisonAI: CodeAgent Executes LLM-Generated Code Without Sandboxing and Leaks All Environment Secrets
### Summary
`CodeAgent._execute_python()` executes LLM-generated Python code in a subprocess with the complete parent-process environment (`os.environ.copy()`), zero AST validation, zero import restrictions, and no sandbox enforcement — even when `CodeConfig(sandbox=True)` is explicitly set. items.title_zh: NetBoard CRM SQL 注入漏洞
items.summary_zh: CRM 系統登入恢復頁面存在 SQL 注入，可導致資料外洩與系統受損。
items.fix_hint: 請參考官方公告進行修補。
items.desc_en: SQL injection in the NetBoard CRM demo platform; specifically, the vulnerable component is the ‘user-name’ POST parameter in the ‘/module/auth/recovery.php’ endpoint. The parameter is vulnerable to blind attacks based on Boolean, error, time-based and UNION techniques. Exploitation allows attackers to extract confidential information (such as the version and type of backend used), alter data or further compromise the CRM environment.

items.title_zh: Microsoft Partner Center 權限提升

items.fix_hint: 請參考 Microsoft 安全更新指南。
items.desc_en: Improper certificate validation in Microsoft Partner Center allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

items.fix_hint: 請參考 GitHub 安全公告進行修補。

PraisonAI: AICoder Arbitrary File Write and Command Execution via LLM Tool Calls
### Summary
The `AICoder` UI component exposes `write_to_file` and `execute_command` tools to the LLM with no path validation and no command sanitization. An attacker can achieve arbitrary file write to any location on the filesystem (including `/root/.ssh/authorized_keys`, `/etc/crontab`) and arbitrary command execution through prompt injection in the chat interface. Docker containers run as root, maximizing impact.
